description: Defines a custom RootNode class extending YAHOO.widget.Node, representing the special virtual root node in a tree view structure, overriding specific methods for presentation logic.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.RootNode
classes.description: A custom node representing the virtual root node with no presentation in a tree view.

methods.name: YAHOO.widget.RootNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the root node with a reference to the tree object.

methods.name: getNodeHtml()
methods.description: Overrides the default getNodeHtml method to return an empty string, representing no visual content for the root node.
